summary: A static blog with file-based posts, draft and unlisted publishing, RSS and a sitemap.
description: Publish articles as MDX files with checked metadata and explicit draft, published and unlisted states. Astro builds the reading pages, RSS feed and sitemap; React islands handle the interactions you choose to add. The recipe includes post scaffolding and optional generated social images. Hosting is separate: select cloudflare-pages if you want its deployment workflow.
seoDescription: A static Astro blog with MDX posts, draft and unlisted publishing, RSS and a sitemap, with React islands for selected interactions.

projectExamples.title: Engineering field notes
projectExamples.description: Write technical articles with embedded React demonstrations. The recipe handles post visibility and feeds; you write the content and demonstrations.

projectExamples.title: Project journal on Cloudflare Pages
projectExamples.description: Publish a file-based development journal with production and preview deployments by adding cloudflare-pages. Create the Pages project and configure deployment credentials separately.
